## How to Use the Manual

Access the manual via the Open Dental website ( [www.opendental.com](http://www.opendental.com/)) or from within Open Dental, [Main Menu](https://opendental.com/manual/mainmenu.html), Help:

Online Help - Contents: Opens this page.

Online Help - Index: Opens the [Search](http://www.opendental.com/manual/searchManual.html) page.

![](https://opendental.com/manual/images/helpIcon.gif) Customers on support may click the Help Icon at the top of each window within the Open Dental program to open the [Help Feature](https://opendental.com/manual/helpfeature.html) for the corresponding manual page.
